newsitem.title: CHINA: China bill clearing system launched in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: China bill clearing system launched in Shanghai.

text.p: An electronic bill clearing and distribution system went into formal operation on Friday at the China's bill exchange under the Shanghai branch of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The new system is capable of handling 1,825 financial bills per minute and will improve the use of funds in China's financial hub, the Xinhua news agency said.

Along with the rapid development of Shanghai's banking sector, the number of bills handled by the exchange soared to an average of 200,000 in 1996, double the figure in 1995, with total value growing from 700 million yuan to some 13.9 billion, it said. It did not clarify how the average was calculated.
The new system now covers 843 local banking institutions, including more than 40 foreign banks, it said.
The system will also be open to banks in surrounding areas to accelerate the banking business, it said, but gave no more details.
